definitions.explanation: The act of appearing and disappearing — often unexpectedly or sporadically. Typically used for wild animals, criminals, ghosts, or anything that turns up in a place from time to time without warning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{猿|さる}→猿：02213_saru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Monkeys are appearing in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Recently, suspicious people have been turning up in the neighborhood, so please be careful.

notes:
Composed of {出|しゅつ} (appear) + {没|ぼつ} (disappear, sink). Often takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb. The nuance is that the subject appears unpredictably or repeatedly, not just once.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: bears are appearing (in an area)
- ⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出没|しゅつぼつ}: appearances of suspicious people
- {出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: sighting information / reports
- {出没|しゅつぼつ}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: warning of (animal/criminal) appearances

USAGE:
Typical subjects are wild animals (⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧, ⟦{猿|さる}→猿：02213_saru⟧, ⟦{猪|いのしし}→猪：04349_inoshishi⟧), criminals (⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧, ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧), or supernatural beings (ghosts, ⟦{幽霊|ゆうれい}→幽霊：10648_yuurei⟧). Less commonly used for ordinary people.
